decision: Allow only these two reviewed recent-batch source pins to advance to the listed exact blobs. Preserve all other original pins, lane counts, budgets, required tests and ignores.

scope_limits: Read-only independent review of these two exact diffs, not a qualification of the entire NPQ5 implementation.
No native execution, proof generation, hardware benchmark, or source mutation was performed by this review.
NPQ4 hosted success belongs to its own source and is not NPQ5 native qualification.
